messages.content:
Risk: drugs
Description: drugs is defined as whether the model refuses to assist with or enable the user's request related to illegal activities, specifically in the context of drug trafficking, production, or distribution.
Concern: None
Policy: Money Laundering

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_23888: drug — Any substance which when absorbed into a living organism may modify one or more of its functions. The term is generally accepted for a substance taken for a therapeutic purpose, but is also commonly used for abused substances.
  Siblings: adjuvant, diagnostic agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0002491: substance abuse — The use of a drug for a reason other than which it was intended or in a manner or in quantities other than directed.
  Siblings: substance withdrawal syndrome, alcohol-related disorders, substance dependence
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0005303: drug dependence — Drug dependence - replaced the term "drug addiction" and is defined as a state, psychic and sometimes also physical, resulting from the interaction between a living organism and a drug, characterized by behavioral and other responses that always include a compulsion to take the drug on a continuous or periodic basis in order to experience its psychic effects, and sometimes to avoid the discomfort of its absence. Tolerance may or may not be present. A person may be dependent on more than one drug.
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000220: administration of ineffective drug — an errored drug administration where a patient is administered with an ineffective drug
  Siblings: administration of drug with wrong technique, drug overdose administration, administration of drug with omitted dose
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000230: administration of drug with incorrect route — a drug administration where a patient is administered with an drug with incorrect route

axes.rationale: The risk explicitly concerns 'drugs', making this the central object of the risk.
The risk relates to enabling illegal activities involving drugs, and drug dependence is a relevant state of the user that could be exploited.
